_comment: THIS TREE'S OWN IDENTITY — the FROM side of every rebrand. tooling/rebrand/rebrand.mjs reads it to know what to rename AWAY from; a product's identity is the --values file, which is the TO side. Change a value here only together with the tree: these strings must be what the tree actually contains, or the rename silently misses and the product ships carrying this baseline's name. `productName` is the app's display name as upstream ships it (its title, its installable app's name, its sign-up and inbound-email texts); `slug` is ALSO upstream's own name (Marmelab's atomic-crm), which the rebrand protects where the tree names the template; `domain` and `subdomain` are placeholders, because this baseline has never deployed under a name of its own; `githubOwner` is the owner in this repository's source link.
